title: Chinese Bike After 6 Months (4500km) | Tavelo Arow

takeaways.text: The frameset has been trouble-free: the plain press-in bottom bracket still spins well and the seatpost has never slipped.
His only frame complaint is that Tavelo still had not published wind-tunnel data to support its aero claims.
Aftermarket chainrings kept dropping the chain with 12-speed Ultegra, so he switched to stiffer rings; he went back from a light Chinese cassette to Ultegra for better shifting.
He runs a 32 mm rear tire and a 28 mm front tire that he recalls measures about 31.5 mm on his wide rims.

disclosure: Owner update; no sponsorship is stated. The 2025 video covers the original Arow frameset and does not say whether it matches the current Race or SL version.
summary: A six-month, 4,500 km update on a raced Tavelo Arow build, going part by part.
